packet.title: Serializer: HTML, text, JSON, CSV; fn:serialize — Early
packet.summary: Adds the HTML, text, JSON and CSV output methods on the serializer pipeline, the parameter reader in src/serialize_parameters.c, and fn:serialize with element and map parameters.

body.p: After . Owns src/serialize_html.c, src/serialize_json.c, src/serialize_text.c, src/function_library_serialize.c, tests/serialize_html_test.c, tests/serialize_json_test.c. HTML method (versions 4 and 5, void elements, raw text elements, boolean attributes, include-content-type, escape-uri-attributes), text, JSON (nodes by json-node-output-method, SERE0020/0022/0023), CSV; fn:serialize with element and map parameters. Done when method-html, method-text, method-json, method-csv, fn-serialize ≥ 90%. Spec: Serialization 4.0 per method. Done 2026-10-17 (): every method on the 3.3 pipeline (escape styles HTML, none, JSON, CSV; raw text), HTML as a mode of the XML node writer, src/serialize_parameters.c (the parameter reader), fn:serialize. fn-serialize 48 to 165/194 (wrong errors 48 to 3); the 32 left need expath binary, fn:parse-csv, fn:unparsed-text, an entity fix in the parser, or XQuery character references. method-* are XQuery-only: unit cases until 3.10 and 3.13.
